name: Why shouldn't I clean biohazards myself?

mainEntity.name: Why shouldn't I clean biohazards myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cleaning biohazards yourself is extremely dangerous and not recommended. Biological materials can contain harmful pathogens, bacteria, and viruses that pose serious health risks, including hepatitis, HIV, and other infectious diseases. Without proper training, personal protective equipment (PPE), and specialized disinfectants, you risk exposure, further contamination, and improper disposal, which can lead to legal penalties. Professional services ensure the area is safely and thoroughly decontaminated according to health regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleaning biohazards yourself is dangerous due to health risks from pathogens and the need for specialized equipment, training, and proper disposal to avoid further contamination and legal issues.
